description: Version 3 curated orders. Items are in the version 2 key-order shape with runtimeMs (decimal string). Inputs: seed and n give seedN (seed_n); repeatGapMs and pairUpToMs (decimal strings, ms); alignToGrid and gridMinutes (the slot of a run); weights (title ID to 1..3, absent means 1); franchises (film ID to collection ID, the franchise map, already resolved). groups, in group ID order: groupId, kind (series, franchise or single), key = splitmix64(seedN + fnv1a64(groupIdBytes)), size, startIndex = key mod size, weight w(g) (the largest weight of its members' titles), startPass = floorDiv((key mod 5400000) * 6, w), queue (members in in-group key order for a series, release order for a franchise, rotated to start at startIndex). walk lists every step: clock before the step, ready (the ready groups, sorted by ID), relaxed (true when no live group was ready, so the smallest last(g) chose), chosen, run (item IDs), slot, passBefore and passAfter of the chosen group (decimal strings). order is the emitted runs written one after another and runs the runs, before any is left out.

vectors.name: curated, pairs: a 6-episode and a 5-episode series of 22-minute episodes (odd tail), a film and a loose episode, defaults, seed 101
vectors.note: Every episode is 22 minutes, at most pairUpToMs (35 min), so each series step takes two episodes; the 5-episode series ends its queue with a single (a series group with one member left never pairs). The loose episode (no series ID) is a group of one and never pairs, though it is 25 minutes. Queues start at key mod size.

vectors.name: curated, weights 1, 2 and 3: three series of eight 44-minute episodes and a franchise whose middle film has weight 2, repeat gap 0, seed 101
vectors.note: Weights: series ...5e0008 1 (written out), ...5e0009 2, ...5e000a 3; in the franchise ...c0110001 the film ...f117000c has weight 2, so the group weight is 2 (the largest over its members). A pass grows by floorDiv(runtime * 6, w). With repeatGapMs 0 every group is always ready, so the passes alone decide: for the same airtime the weight-3 series comes round about three times as often as the weight-1 series while both have episodes left.
